title: I think my dreams have been invaded
content: Ok this is weird, I haven't been having my traditional Mall world dreams lately and feel that they have been hijacked. Almost every dream these past several months have been me and my partner going after the "Fedora Cult", we've been unsuccessful at capturing them or seeing there faces. Last night I went to a reoccurring Dream scape. I knew what I was going to do there and who I was going to see. When my guide showed up I recognized her as my partner and instead of going to the feast of fairies like we normally do, we wound up getting spied on by the Fedoras. After chasing them through the abandoned town and forest we lost them. It's bizarre just bizarre, every dream.
